title: 공소청, '100억대 불법 정치자금 의혹' 전광훈 구속영장 청구
caption:
Prosecutors have requested an arrest warrant for Pastor Jeon Gwang-hoon over allegations of illegal political funding involving over 10 billion won in church money. The investigation focuses on whether funds were funneled to the Jayu-tongildang party in violation of the Political Funds Act.
